title: Hind
extract:
The Hind is a  Grineer burst rifle used by their Elite Lancers. It fires five-round bursts while maintaining a low recoil allowing all rounds fired to land very close to one another, but has poor critical stats. Pressing Alternate Fire shoots single rounds with higher damage per bullet and critical stats but lower status.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Slash damage.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Primary Burst Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest number of shots per burst out of all burst-fire rifles.
Burst-fire has low recoil.
Burst Mode (wiki attack index 1)
High magazine size (65)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
High accuracy (0.00° to 6.00°)
High ammo max (540)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.42x))
Semi-Auto Mode (wiki attack index 2)
Very high magazine size (65)
Above average accuracy (0.00° to 7.00°)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.42x))
Disadvantages over other Primary Burst Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Burst-fire mode:
Tied with  Burston and  Kuva Hind for the lowest base damage per bullet of all burst-fire rifles.
Linearly less efficient – sometimes a target may only die with six bullets, which requires an entire second burst to be fired. However, this can be circumvented by using the semi-auto single shot.
Semi-auto mode:
Tied with  Kuva Hind and  Nagantaka for the third slowest fire rate of all semi-automatic rifles, after  Grinlok/ Prisma Grinlok and  Kuva Chakkhurr.

Acquisition
The Hind's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Notes
This weapon was introduced in Update 9.6 (2013-08-16).
Mods that affect fire rate will also affect the burst rate, making the Hind very deadly with mods that increase the firerate, and even more so with the addition of punch through.

Tips
New players who prefer burst fire but cannot afford this weapon's heavy building cost should stick with the  Burston until they have enough resources.
The Hind is made significantly better against enemy groups with the addition of  Shred or  Metal Auger.
 Stabilizer effectively reduces the recoil on every burst giving it more pin point precision over long distances or for better headshots.

Trivia
The Hind is one of the Grineer weapons to be showcased in the Chemical Lab.
The Hind probably derives its name from the NATO reporting name for the famous Mil Mi-24 helicopter gunship/troop transport. Other probable sources of the weapon's name include:
A lesser known aircraft, the Hawker Hind, is a pre-WWII British propeller driven bomber.
The Golden Hind, Captain Sir Francis Drake's privateer galleon.
A lunar crater named Hind.
The Hind is one of the few Grineer weapons that are not focused on  Impact damage, and instead focused mostly on  Slash. This makes them the least effective gun unit in the Grineer arsenal at taking down shields and punching through armor, while being better equipped against the Infested or Corpus enemies with shields down.
